description: This PHP class 'SearchDefsDocumentifier' converts SugarBean objects into searchable document representations within the SuiteCRM framework. It uses a configuration file to determine which fields to index and handles parsing and mapping of data for indexing purposes.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifier
classes.description: A class that transforms SugarBean objects into indexed documents using configurable search definitions, supporting flexible field mapping and processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger and the array mapper with configuration loaded from a YAML file.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Main method that takes a SugarBean and optional parser, extracts relevant fields, processes them, and returns a mapped document ready for indexing.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndex
methods.description: Parses search definition files for a given module to generate a list of fields to be indexed, excluding certain keys and handling special cases.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndexCached
methods.description: Caches the fields to index for each module to avoid repeated parsing.

methods.name: parseBeans
methods.description: Extracts specified fields from a SugarBean object into an array for indexing, considering nested array values.
